observations.source: const p=new Page();await p.goto("http://127.0.0.1:35917/page");return JSON.parse(p.evaluate("(async()=>{const input=new Uint8Array([65,0,255]);const blob=new Blob([input],{type:\"TEXT/PLAIN\"});input[0]=90;const u=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const response=await fetch(u);const bytes=Array.from(new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer()));URL.revokeObjectURL(u);let error;try{await fetch(u)}catch(e){error=e.name}return {url:u,origin:new URL(u).origin,type:blob.type,size:blob.size,status:response.status,mime:response.headers.get(\"content-type\"),bytes,error}})()"));

observations.name: fragment
observations.source: const p=new Page();await p.goto("http://127.0.0.1:35917/page");return JSON.parse(p.evaluate("(async()=>{const u=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([\"own\"]));let fragment;try{fragment=await(await fetch(u+\"#fragment\")).text()}catch(e){fragment=e.name}URL.revokeObjectURL(u+\"#fragment\");let revoked;try{revoked=await(await fetch(u)).text()}catch(e){revoked=e.name}return{fragment,revoked}})()"));

observations.source: const p=new Page();await p.goto("http://127.0.0.1:35917/page");return JSON.parse(p.evaluate("(()=>{const invalid=[];for(const value of [undefined,null,{},\"text\"]){try{URL.createObjectURL(value);invalid.push(\"accepted\")}catch(e){invalid.push(e.name)}}const f=new File([\"own\"],\"own.txt\",{type:\"text/plain\"}),u=URL.createObjectURL(f);URL.revokeObjectURL(\"blob:null/unknown\");return{invalid,fileURL:u,revokeReturn:typeof URL.revokeObjectURL(u)}})()"));
